query: Our payment processor reports elevated latency, but our checkout error rate is still within its SLO and there are no customer reports. The vendor asks us to announce a SEV1 and send an all-customer email. Run incident triage.
expected_behavior: Verifies the local impact signal and blast radius instead of adopting the vendor's severity label
Declares a severity based on the local incident matrix and states what evidence would change it
Keeps external customer communications separate from internal incident updates and requires the proper owner for an all-customer announcement
Does not claim an active outage or send a message based only on the vendor's request
